items.reason: Both promises (P-A7-phone-watch-3-02, P-A7-phone-watch-3-03) are broken on body weight by an existing finding: the workout picture's 'more than last time' line is worked out from the full total, which counts body weight on pull-ups and dips. The kg box, records, month and year pictures and before/after picture leave body weight out; no picture is given the member's name (only the workout's own name, exercise names and the gym); the gym is only drawn when a gym is passed and Show is chosen.

This area is on-phone logic and picture drawing: no notice, consent, sign-up or age screen lives here. Purpose: a share picture leaves the phone only when the member taps Share. Deletion: the per-workout Delete asks first and hands off to the delete service outside this area. Breach timing and children: nothing in this area to judge.
The area holds no server read, no staff screen and no gym data view; it reads only the member's own data on the phone.
The area keeps nothing on its own: no storage, file or cache writes found; the items list gives 0 entities with personal data here.

No network call, analytics, AI, WhatsApp or Health service call in catalog, lib or share; exercise drawings are bundled in the app. The share sheet line 'Your photos stay on this phone until you tap Share picture' is not true when the opt-in photo backup is on; same fault as the existing photo-backup finding.

Only one delete lives here, the per-workout Delete; it calls the delete service (outside this area) and reports failure only when the workout is still there. Account deletion is not in this area; the server-copy side belongs to the cloud area.
